source: Authored for S02 (Issue #73) from the device-info field list in docs/architecture/protocol.md and the probe rules in docs/architecture/discovery.md. Not captured from a physical television.
redaction: Contains no address, MAC, Wi-Fi name, token, serial or certificate. Hosts are placeholders such as [host-a]; address-like and identifying device-info fields are replaced with bracketed placeholders; UUIDs are randomly generated for this fixture.
notes: Three candidates whose device-info cannot be used: one returns a non-JSON body, one never answers (no entry), and one returns a document that names a different host than the one probed. Expect no card and never an address as a label.
